nodes.label: Hard breakpoints
nodes.rationale: Python tracing is per thread; entering a hard breakpoint gives the debugger access to install a tracer in that thread.

nodes.label: Generated source policy
nodes.rationale: Designer round trips only support constructs it can generate; custom code belongs outside maintained _init_* methods.

nodes.label: Source code as persistence
nodes.rationale: Generated applications need only their generated source, without distributing Boa runtime files; source is educational, editable, and reusable.

nodes.label: Sizer layout
nodes.rationale: Controls need flexible space when translations change text length or lists and grids grow.

nodes.label: Help index cache
nodes.rationale: A docs-cache directory in resource configuration allows index caching when the installation directory is not writable.

nodes.label: Single version source
nodes.rationale: The packaging guide uses __version__.py as the single source of truth for release versions.
